title: Design stage over-proportions output: 19 FRs + 15 NFRs for one trivial feature; 314KB partial blows run time/cost
body: Design over-proportions output. agents/design.agent.json instructs an FR for EVERY feature (no exceptions), full acceptance criteria, plus NFRs and user stories, with NO per-feature proportionality cap, and the under-500-lines rule is unenforced. Observed on MyToDo stage 1 (design): a trivial feature F-1 Create todo produced 19 FRs + 15 NFRs + 13 user stories; design-output.md.partial already 314KB; stage-1 output ~140k tokens over 11 calls (~10k output tokens each), while the agent declares expected ~5k input / ~10k output / 2-5 min. Combined with the per-feature strategy (10 features) this exhausts time/cost. Inputs were small and sane (~5-8k tokens) - it is output over-elaboration, not bad input data.

rcca.root_cause: The design agent prompt mandates exhaustive per-feature requirements (FR per feature + NFRs + user stories) with no proportionality cap and no enforced length budget; the per-feature strategy multiplies by feature count, so a simple feature becomes a large spec.
rcca.corrective: Add proportionality: cap/scale requirements per feature to feature complexity, dedupe product-wide NFRs (not per feature), and enforce the doc length budget (fail or trim when exceeded).
rcca.preventive: Test: a simple feature yields a bounded requirement count and design doc size; assert the length cap is enforced.
